Name: Nepheg, Son of David
Summary: Nepheg, son of David, was born at Jerusalem and named among the sons born to him there. He is distinct from Nepheg son of Izhar of the Exodus generation.
KeyStory: Nepheg son of David was born at Jerusalem, sharing a name with an older Nepheg.
LifeLesson: Old names return in new generations, and the record keeps them straight.
